text:
Maya (partnerships): quick q — we need a clear trigger for SI outbound on blue-tier accounts. propose: account ARR >= $250k OR existing infra spend > $100k. thoughts?
Jon P. (sales): seems reasonable. what about strategic logos we want to protect even if <$250k?
Maya (partnerships): good catch. add manual escalate flag for named accounts, @Kevin can curate list.
Kevin (partner-eng): I can maintain a blacklist/whitelist. prefer a combined rule: ARR>=250k OR infra>=100k OR in_named_list=true
Samir (sysint): practical ask — when an SI claims a lead, do they get full outreach rights or need co-sell approval? we had noisy touch overlap before.
Ana L. (revops): recommend SI gets initial qualifying outreach (email + 1 call) then needs AE handoff to proceed. keeps funnel tidy.
Jon P. (sales): +1. After SI quali, AE ownership transfer via CRM change + slack notify to #sales-handovers.
Maya (partnerships): here's a sample mapping snippet for revops to implement:
```
trigger:
  - condition: ARR >= 250000
  - condition: infra_spend >= 100000
  - condition: account_in_named_list == true
actions:
  - route_to: si-intake-queue
  - notify: #partners-claims
```
Ana L. (revops): can we also add retroactive crediting rules? if SI starts outreach but AE closes, credit split 70/30 unless customer chose SI as primary.
Kevin (partner-eng): ack. need policy doc for commission ops. I'll draft and loop in finance.
Samir (sysint): ops question — do we allow SI to create GDRs in CRM or only tasks? we should restrict stage moves until AE accepts.
Jon P. (sales): restrict stage move. SI can create tasks/notes, AE moves to opportunity.
Maya (partnerships): timeline: revops to implement mapping + crm triggers by EOW, Kevin to share named list by Thu, Kevin/finance draft crediting policy next week.
Marketplace Bot: Reminder: marketplace listing update scheduled for 2024-11-15 — ensure SI co-sell blurb added.
Maya (partnerships): thanks all. tagging next steps: @Ana L. implement rules, @Kevin prepare list & policy, @Samir confirm CRM gating. Will follow up in Thursday sync. :thumbsup:
